Class TypeAbstract<T>

java.lang.Object
com.kamikazejam.kamicommon.command.type.TypeAbstract<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Type<T>, Named
Direct Known Subclasses:
TypeAbstractChoice, TypeAbstractException, TypeColor, TypeEnumChoice, TypeNamespacedKey, TypeOfflinePlayer, TypePlayer, TypeSender, TypeString, TypeStringConfirmation
public abstract class TypeAbstract<T> extends Object implements Type<T>
The base for every Type, supplying a display name derived from the class name, identity and equality helpers, and prefix filtering of tab completions. Implement Type.read(String, CommandSender) to parse the argument and Type.getTabList(CommandSender, String) to offer completions, rejecting bad input by throwing KamiCommonException with a message for the sender rather than by returning null. Completions are filtered against the partial argument unless shouldShowAllTabCompletions() is overridden to return true.
